# Third-party project manifest

Checked 2026-10-24. Clones are isolated under this ignored directory; do not copy their source into first-party folders. Ports 4000–4008 are reserved in table order. Libraries and datasets are not standalone web services, so their assigned ports are reserved and no URL is expected. WLASL videos must not be downloaded.

| Project | Status | Port / URL | Clone, install, and run commands | License | Date checked |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [LibreLingo](https://github.com/LibreLingo/LibreLingo) | reference only — upstream says repository is archived; no app started | 4000 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/LibreLingo/LibreLingo.git thirdparty/librelingo`; development instructions: https://librelingo.app/docs/ | AGPL-3.0 | 2026-10-24 |
| [duolingo-clone (sanidhyy)](https://github.com/sanidhyy/duolingo-clone) | blocked — requires Clerk keys, Neon/PostgreSQL, and Stripe credentials | 4001 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/sanidhyy/duolingo-clone.git thirdparty/duolingo-clone`; README setup requires `pnpm install`, `.env.local`, and Clerk publishable/secret keys, Neon `DATABASE_URL`, Stripe API/webhook secrets, and Clerk admin IDs; do not start with placeholder credentials | MIT | 2026-10-24 |
| [sign.mt / Rylo Translate](https://github.com/sign/translate) | reference only — no local inference/server run command is documented; upstream links to its hosted app | 4002 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/sign/translate.git thirdparty/sign-translate`; upstream hosted app: https://rylo.com/sign/translate/ | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use; commercial license required | 2026-10-24 |
| [sign-language-processing](https://github.com/sign-language-processing) | reference only — supplied URL is an organization page, not a cloneable project repository | 4003 reserved | No clone or install command; select a repository from the organization before cloning | unverified | 2026-10-24 |
| [OpenHands (AI4Bharat)](https://github.com/AI4Bharat/OpenHands) | reference only — Python recognition library and models, not a standalone local web app | 4004 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/AI4Bharat/OpenHands.git thirdparty/openhands`; upstream install: `pip install --upgrade OpenHands`; no server command documented | Apache-2.0 | 2026-10-24 |
| [MediaPipe](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe) | reference only — SDK/toolkit, not a standalone local web app; source checkout is large | 4005 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe.git thirdparty/mediapipe`; use the platform-specific official setup guides; no server command | Apache-2.0 | 2026-10-24 |
| [LiveKit server](https://github.com/livekit/livekit) | installed — local Docker development server verified; stopped after check | 4006 | `docker run --rm -d --name signlangai-livekit -p 4006:7880 livekit/livekit-server:v1.13.10 --dev --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 7880`; stop: `docker stop signlangai-livekit` | Apache-2.0 | 2026-10-24 |
| [ts-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs) | reference only — TypeScript library, not a standalone web service; upstream v6 requires Node.js 24+ | 4007 reserved | Clone: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs.git thirdparty/ts-fsrs`; package install: `pnpm add ts-fsrs`; no server command | MIT | 2026-10-24 |
| [WLASL](https://github.com/dxli94/WLASL) | reference only — dataset index only; do not download videos | 4008 reserved | Clone metadata/index only: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/dxli94/WLASL.git thirdparty/wlasl`; do not run `video_downloader.py` or download videos | unverified (no repository license detected) | 2026-10-24 |

The local LiveKit server uses development credentials and is for local testing only. Do not reuse its dev credentials outside localhost.
